title: Qt: Fix find-in-packet follow-up
description:
Follow-up fixes for the find-in-packet feature after the previous MRs were merged before review was complete.

Addresses remaining review feedback and a few behavioural issues (search type restore, display-filter placeholder/autocomplete in in-packet mode, packet-selection crash).

Previous MR: !25219

commits_data.title: Qt: Fix find-in-packet follow-up issues
commits_data.message:
Qt: Fix find-in-packet follow-up issues

- Revert master_split_ pointer refactor; restore embedded QSplitter
- Move in_packet_search_ init out of HAVE_LIBPCAP guard
- Remove unused edit-find-in icon
- Generalize status bar supplement API (drop find-specific helpers)
- Fix search type restore, display-filter placeholder, and autocomplete in in-packet mode
- Fix crash on packet change (stale match indices, deferred re-search)
- Add UI spacer in search frame toolbar

AI-Assisted: yes (Claude)
